templateName: Full extraction (transcript, SOP, BOM, lab summary)
description: Transcribes the selected videos with Amazon Transcribe and derives the SOP, the LCA bill of materials, the lab summary and verification key frames with Amazon Bedrock.
inputInstructions:
Select 1-4 narrated video files (MP4, MOV, M4V, WebM, MKV) explicitly, in playback order. Selection order is honoured when this pipeline is the workflow's first step; as a later step of a custom workflow the files arrive in path order, so set VIDEO_ORDER to filename or name the files in playback order (GX010001.MP4, GX010002.MP4). Whole-asset ('/') and folder selections are refused at execute. The narration is the source of every deliverable: a selection whose audio carries no detectable speech is refused (VideoSopBomInputRejected) rather than processed.

Limits: this deployment's caps default to 4 files, 4 GB per video, 16 GB in total and 240 minutes of audio, and may be lower. A refused run names the active limit in its error; every run records the active values in results/summary.json.

Outputs land in sop-bom/<executionId>/ on the asset: transcript.json, transcript.txt, transcript.vtt, transcript.srt, video-timeline.json, sop.json, sop.md, bom.json, bom.md, bom.csv, lab-summary.json and lab-summary.md (when GENERATE_LAB_SUMMARY is true), frames.json, keyframe-*.jpg and analysis-report.json. Asset metadata keys prefixed sopBom_ summarise the run.

Product name precedence: PRODUCT_NAME, then the asset name. ADDITIONAL_INSTRUCTIONS adjusts the emphasis and vocabulary of the extraction prompts; it cannot change the output schema.

tagSchema.label: Transcription language
tagSchema.description: The language Amazon Transcribe expects in the narration. auto asks Amazon Transcribe to identify it; set an explicit language when the narration is sparse, since language identification needs enough speech to sample.

tagSchema.label: Video order
tagSchema.description: selection keeps the order the files were selected in (honoured when this pipeline is the workflow's first step); filename sorts the files naturally by relative path, for chaptered camera files such as GX010001.MP4, GX010002.MP4.

tagSchema.label: Product name
tagSchema.description: The product being torn down. Blank uses the asset name. At most 256 characters.

tagSchema.label: Contributors
tagSchema.description: Names recorded in the lab summary header. At most 256 characters.

tagSchema.label: Maximum key frames
tagSchema.description: Upper bound on the key frames extracted for visual verification (1-200).

tagSchema.label: Part level base
tagSchema.description: The part_level value of top-level BOM rows: 0 or 1.

tagSchema.label: Generate lab summary
tagSchema.description: Write lab-summary.json and lab-summary.md alongside the SOP and BOM.

tagSchema.label: Additional instructions
tagSchema.description: Appended to the extraction prompts under the system boundary; adjusts emphasis and vocabulary, never the output schema. At most 4000 characters.
